title: Unified observation record, six snapshot schemas, and address-library migration
objective: Implement the versioned-parser ingress contract from docs/METHODS_ALPHA_SCORE_AND_DETECTORS.md Part 3: the ObservationRecord type, the six typed snapshot schemas (market/security/holder_concentration/wallet_signal/promotion_and_social/call_source), and additive migration 008_address_library_and_observations.sql creating wallets, wallet_token_edges and observations. Chain amounts are raw-integer strings; borrowed fields carry origin=borrowed and verification_status=unverified until first-hand confirms; partial data lowers completeness and never fabricates precision. No live network.
forbidden_actions: Do not use network APIs, credentials, live providers or scraping.
Do not store chain quantities as floating-point numbers; raw-integer strings only.
Do not mark any borrowed (platform-sourced) field as verified without a first-hand confirmation path.
Do not write destructive ALTER/DROP against existing tables; migration 008 is additive only.
Do not put any secret, key, credential or raw provider payload into fixtures or the repo.
